What the model knows

This is a navigable spatial interpretation, built from published photos and the official description. The stage geometry, balcony, seven skyboxes, red booth seating, lighting, and spiral stair echo the available material. Exact dimensions and sightlines were not published.

Official VIP services: skyboxes, capacity, bottle service ↗ Firsthand forum review: three floors, stage activity, service ↗ Published interior photo source ↗ 2024 video review found during research ↗
Open question: no published floor plan, skybox minimum, bottle price list, or direct reviewer comparison was found. Treat this as a decision aid, not an exact preview of the room.
